instance_name.description: The name of the Bigtable instance.

column_family.description: The name of the column family.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

mode.description: If multiple policies are set, you should choose between `UNION` OR `INTERSECTION`.

max_age.description: GC policy that applies to all cells older than the given age.

max_version.description: GC policy that applies to all versions of a cell except for the most recent.

gc_rules.description: Serialized JSON object to represent a more complex GC policy. Conflicts with `mode`, `max_age` and `max_version`. Conflicts with `mode`, `max_age` and `max_version`.

deletion_policy.description: The deletion policy for the GC policy. Setting ABANDON allows the resource to be abandoned rather than deleted. This is useful for GC policy as it cannot be deleted in a replicated instance. Possible values are: `ABANDON`. ----- `max_age` supports the following arguments:

days.description: Number of days before applying GC policy.

duration.description: Duration before applying GC policy (ex. "8h"). This is required when `days` isn't set ----- `max_version` supports the following arguments:

number.description: Number of version before applying the GC policy. ----- `gc_rules` include 2 fields: - `mode`: optional, either `intersection` or `union`. - `rules`: an array of GC policy rule, can be specified as JSON object: `{"max_age": "16h"}` or `{"max_version": 2}` - If `mode` is not specified, `rules` can only contains one GC policy. If `mode` is specified, `rules` must have at least 2 policies.
